findings.what_changed: Acme added a risk that tariffs on imported battery cells could raise its costs.
findings.triage_reason: New tariff exposure on imported components.

findings.what_changed: Acme added a risk about relying on a single supplier for its infotainment semiconductors.
Acme added that a class action lawsuit alleges its driver-assistance claims were misleading.
Acme expanded its cybersecurity risk to include ransomware attacks on its factories.
findings.triage_reason: Broader cyberattack risk at its plants.

findings.what_changed: Acme added a risk that its CEO's public statements could hurt its brand.
Acme added a risk that rising interest rates could reduce demand from customers who finance purchases.
Birch Foods added that drought could raise the cost of the wheat it buys.
findings.triage_reason: Commodity input cost risk from weather.

findings.what_changed: Birch Foods added new EU rules requiring recyclable packaging.
Birch Foods added that it recalled contaminated snack bars, which cut its sales.
Birch Foods added that labor shortages at its bakeries raised wage costs.
Birch Foods expanded its risk on data breaches of its loyalty program.
Cobalt Media added that streaming subscriber growth may slow.
Cobalt Media added patent infringement lawsuits over its streaming technology.
Cobalt Media added that the FCC may not renew its broadcast licenses.
Cobalt Media added a restructuring plan that closes two studios, with charges.
Cobalt Media added a risk that new import duties on electronics raise its device costs.

queries.name: tariffs-raised-costs
queries.text: Tariffs imposed in 2027 on battery cells imported from Asia have increased our costs and reduced our gross margin.
queries.why: Acme's own tariff finding shares the words; Cobalt's import duties are the same kind of risk.

queries.name: customs-duties-paraphrase
queries.text: Customs duties on the packaging film we buy from overseas suppliers are expected to increase our expenses.
queries.why: Duties on imports, like both tariff findings; Birch's packaging-rules finding shares 'packaging' but is about regulation, not duties.

queries.name: customers-sued-paraphrase
queries.text: Several customers have sued us, claiming that our lane-keeping features did not perform as advertised.
queries.why: The same lawsuit topic in other words ('sued', 'lane-keeping', 'as advertised'); word overlap is expected to miss it.

queries.name: ransomware-streaming
queries.text: Attackers could use ransomware to disrupt our streaming platform and steal subscriber data.
queries.why: Cyberattacks and data theft; Cobalt's subscriber-growth finding shares 'streaming' and 'subscriber' but is about demand.

queries.name: cereal-recall
queries.text: We recalled certain cereal products after finding contamination, and the recall reduced our net sales.

queries.name: earthquake-nothing
queries.text: An earthquake could damage our headquarters and research center in California.
queries.why: No finding is about natural disasters: recall should return nothing.

queries.name: accounting-nothing
queries.text: Changes in accounting standards may require us to restate previously reported amounts.
queries.why: No finding is about accounting standards.

queries.name: insurance-costs-nothing
queries.text: Our insurance costs could rise as we open new stores in coastal regions.
queries.why: A cost increase from a cause no finding is about; sharing 'costs' and 'new' with the tariff, duty and wage findings must not count as similar.

queries.name: ceo-comments-paraphrase
queries.text: Public comments by our chief executive officer have drawn criticism and may harm our reputation.
queries.why: CEO statements hurting the brand, in other words ('chief executive officer', 'reputation').

queries.name: plant-restructuring
queries.text: We are closing one of our assembly plants as part of a restructuring that will result in charges.
queries.why: Closures under a restructuring plan, with charges.

queries.name: fcc-licenses
queries.text: The FCC may decline to renew our television broadcast licenses in several markets.
queries.why: Cobalt's own earlier FCC license finding.
